artifacts.summary: Milestone schema design (primary_goals, roadmap_milestones, roadmap_context), whole-file render layout with a measured sf1-engine prototype, per-section pruning ledger, migration and losslessness gate, lint retarget disposition, and the files and tests the change reaches.

user_decision.question: In a repository whose specs/ tree is gitignored (sf1-engine, and every repository init-specs.sh now sets up by default), should the generated roadmap stay at specs/ROADMAP.md, where no collaborator sees it, or be publishable at a tracked path?
options: Add an optional roadmap_context.output_path field the renderer honours; default remains specs/ROADMAP.md
Always render to specs/ROADMAP.md; the dashboard stays local wherever specs/ is ignored
user_decision.recommended: Add an optional roadmap_context.output_path field the renderer honours; default remains specs/ROADMAP.md

memory_candidates.content: In the core extension's roadmap entries, the one length-bounded field (roadmap_batches[].description, maxLength 100, enforced by validate-state Check 13) held its bound in 37 of 37 live entries across two repositories, while every unbounded sibling (rationale, roadmap_notes paragraphs) grew to 500-10,800 characters each and made up about 70% of the rendered ROADMAP.md. When adding an agent-authored prose field to state.json that a generator renders, give it a schema maxLength and a validator check at introduction, and run the proposed bound against existing text first: a 200-char bound on goals failed 2 of 3 real paragraphs and a 300-char bound on settled decisions fails 7 of 20.

The state-write backstop hook scans Bash command text: a command that writes any path shaped like *state.json while mentioning active_projects is refused, even when the target is a scratchpad fixture. For a read-only prototype over a real specs/state.json, read the state file unchanged and keep new or experimental keys in a separately named overlay file passed with jq --slurpfile, so no state-shaped file is written at all.

scripts/lint/lint-roadmap-batch-proposals.sh parses the rendered specs/ROADMAP.md, not state.json, so its findings lag state: in one run it reported 1 terminal-member finding where validate-state.sh Check 13 reported 6 on the same store. 316 of its 326 findings in the source repository were finding (a), file_scope overlap with an out-of-batch task, which no other check owns; its single executable call site is scripts/orchestrate-conclusion-roadmap.sh.
